## History

Tobias Corcoran engaged in political corruption by bribing [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally overheard this transaction, which ultimately led Judson to abandon a controversial fence-advertising scheme in order to ensure her silence.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P49](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0049), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_
